title: Evidence baseline and repository
purpose: Establish a reproducible source/evidence contract before writing gameplay.
systems_modules: Evidence/Manifest; Evidence/Decisions; Tools/ValidateEvidence; Content/Schemas; docs/task-cards; build/version-lock
dependencies: This investigation and authorized access to its artifacts.
source_references: All archive hashes; E001-E065; C01-C26; weapon_catalog; file_manifest.
implementation_tasks: Create an isolated TWR-Standalone repository. Record source archives by hash and keep raw evidence outside release content paths.
Import evidence indexes and define original, secondary, harness, capture and proposed provenance labels.
Pin a tested Godot .NET build, SDK and export templates. Define units, IDs, version policy and task-card schema.
Add evidence/content schemas, import fixtures and an acceptance gate register.
validation_tests: Recompute all six archive hashes and 8,033 manifest records; verify 225 scripts, 98 definitions, 91 weapons, nine infected and 21 perks.
Failure fixtures reject changed hashes, unknown values encoded as zero, unresolved evidence IDs and harness constants mislabeled original.
No gameplay code or asset runtime downloads are introduced.
completion_criteria: Commit a reproducible source baseline, decision ledger, toolchain lock and bounded next task cards. Keep all open conflicts.

title: Offline executable and local authority shell
purpose: Prove Windows packaging and the simulation boundary before gameplay.
systems_modules: Runtime/SessionHost; Core/Clock; Contracts/Commands; Contracts/Events; Game.Godot/Bootstrap; build/Windows
dependencies: Stage0.
source_references: E001; T01-T02; section7.
implementation_tasks: Create the Godot frontend and pure C# domain projects, fixed clock, command queue, state snapshots and events.
Add local profile selection, settings shell, diagnostics and solo pause.
Export a Windows build with every required local runtime dependency.
validation_tests: Launch on a clean disconnected Windows 11 system with no Roblox and no assumed .NET preinstallation.
A 60-second clock/replay produces identical domain results across render rates; pause resumes without an accumulated catch-up burst.
The domain builds without Godot; presentation has no direct authoritative mutation path.
completion_criteria: The offline executable boots, selects a local profile and exits with a reproducible package manifest.

title: Safe source extraction and normalized definitions
purpose: Convert evidence to typed data without executing Luau or erasing malformed fields.
dependencies: Stage0; Stage1 for resource loading.
source_references: E003-E010, E015-E018, E022-E027; weapon_catalog; shared/expanded tables.
implementation_tasks: Implement safe literal/expression extraction and XML referent traversal with source spans and hashes.
Normalize units and references while retaining raw expressions, animation channels, sound slices and malformed records.
Generate all 98 definitions, nine infected, 21 perks and four fortification records; expose unresolved asset bindings.
Compile definitions repeatably; never execute uploaded source code.
validation_tests: All imported literal values match frozen evidence; repeated compilation produces identical canonical checksums.
Independent Glock, Sawn Off, MG42, perk, XP and reward fixtures pass.
Dynamic script calls are rejected; Sawn Off Dimensions is quarantined; assignment-based sound tables are retained.
completion_criteria: The shell loads a validated registry with complete evidence links and explicit unknown fields.

title: Laboratory map conversion proof
purpose: Retire the largest asset/geometry risk before building gameplay on a fake map.
dependencies: Stages1-2; authorized geometry or explicit diagnostic placeholders.
source_references: E012-E014, E053-E056; TestPlace_items; map_catalog; markers.
implementation_tasks: Import a connected Lab corridor, research room, stair and garage chunk with primitive geometry, collision and navigation.
Validate scale, basis, hierarchy, invisible walls and local/LOD duplication handling.
Generate a missing mesh/CSG/terrain worklist with authorized export or replacement paths.
Add source-coordinate marker overlays and landmark camera fixtures.
validation_tests: Source transform error is at most 1e-4 stud; axis, 90-degree rotation and parent-local fixtures pass.
Chosen routes traverse correctly; invisible walls are not rendered and actors cannot clip through them.
Source marker groups contain 15 infected, eight player, 127 item and 47 fortification Parts.
Repeated imports are canonical; no Union bounding-box proxy is marked final art.
completion_criteria: Useful Lab geometry and navigation are proven. Critical missing geometry has a concrete resolution path or an explicit blocked gate.

title: Player camera and first person rig
purpose: Establish recognizable motion and weapon framing with measured tunable parameters.
dependencies: Stages1-3; selected player/weapon pose data.
source_references: E006, E020-E021, E057-E059; controls and GripCF/CamAim data; U06-U07.
implementation_tasks: Implement walking, sprinting, jumping, slow movement and ADS action state without unproven crouching or stamina.
Build R6-style arms and source-relative weapon/camera channels; add sensitivity and input settings.
Create a calibrated movement course and comparison captures.
Label unverified speeds, gravity and maximum health as proposed values.
validation_tests: Over ten fixed seconds the selected movement speed yields distance within 0.5%; input behavior remains consistent at 30/60/144 FPS.
Chosen source FOV and pose keyframes match; compiled durations agree within 1 ms.
Lab stairs/doors traverse without unintended snagging; pause freezes gameplay clocks.
completion_criteria: The controller and rig pass engineering tests; retail movement remains blocked until calibrated original evidence resolves U06.

title: Weapon actions and ammunition vertical core

implementation_tasks: Implement layered animation channels, easing, moving parts and committed action events.
Add Glock and Sawn Off fire, equip, aim, reload and switch behavior with an explicit chamber/reload profile.

validation_tests: Glock shot spacing is 150 ms and MG42 diagnostic spacing 50 ms, without render-rate drift.
Magazine/reserve limits are correct; canceled actions cannot create rounds or permit prohibited-phase firing.
Every timeline has annotated action commit and cancellation fixtures; segment durations match source.
completion_criteria: Two gun families work through one traceable framework; uncertain runtime commit rules remain named provisional decisions.

title: Performance regression and long offline soak
purpose: Meet the baseline performance targets while preserving authentic gameplay.
systems_modules: Diagnostics/Profiler; AI/Budgets; World/Streaming; Rendering/LOD; Physics/Pools; Tests/Soak
dependencies: Early Stage6benchmark, Stage16maps, Stage17profiles.
source_references: T03-T05; source map/particle counts; section 20 proposed budgets.
implementation_tasks: Profile CPU/GPU/navigation/rigs/physics/audio/memory in release builds.
Tune pooling, path caching, LOD, chunking and light baking without dropping attacks, damage, loot or rewards.
Run mixed late-wave hordes, explosions/forts, fifty-spawn bursts, repeated map loads and an eight-hour soak.
Record baseline and Ryzen AI Max+ 395/Radeon8060S benchmarks.
validation_tests: Baseline 1080p medium targets 60 FPS with p95 at most 16.67 ms and p99 at most 25 ms under 250-live/150-visible stress.
No repeated spawn frames above 33.3 ms; target peak working RAM at most 4 GiB; cold/warm loading at most ten/three seconds.
After warmup/repeated loads, memory growth is at most 5%; no stale pool/path callbacks or audio overflow.
completion_criteria: Measured release performance passes selected budgets; benchmark population remains separate from original unknown spawn counts.

title: Windows packaging and final offline acceptance
purpose: Ship reproducible fully offline install and test long-term local operation.
systems_modules: build/Windows; Tools/PackageAudit; Tests/Offline; docs/Release; profile migrations
dependencies: All critical gates; rights-approved asset manifest; Stage18.
source_references: Primary goal; T01; asset_rights_register; all traceability/acceptance records.
implementation_tasks: Package ThoseWhoRemainOffline.exe, every required asset and local runtime dependency in an installer/portable distribution.
Audit licenses, external URLs, dynamic downloads and online SDKs/telemetry.
Test standard-user clean Windows installation, disconnected operation, read-only install location and save recovery.
Publish build/dependency manifests, controls/local-profile guide and known fidelity limitations.
validation_tests: A fresh offline system launches without Roblox, Roblox Studio, accounts, servers or internet; all included content is usable.
No required DNS/socket/HTTP or Roblox asset requests occur during a network-blocked run.
Profiles survive 100 launches; corrupt primary recovery works; uninstall policy preserves profiles.
Complete a 24-hour disconnected play/restart/map-load sequence and repeat baseline performance checks.
completion_criteria: A reproducible offline Windows release ships with rights resolved, critical gates passed and an honest fidelity status.
